Third-party code in this folder (all MIT). Loaded lazily by js/misaki-stage.js, only when the "Chat with Misaki"
screen opens and frontend/live2d/misaki/misaki.model3.json exists.

  pixi-6.5.10.min.js                       pixi.js 6.5.10            https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@6.5.10/dist/browser/pixi.min.js
  pixi-unsafe-eval-6.5.10.min.js           @pixi/unsafe-eval 6.5.10  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@pixi/unsafe-eval@6.5.10/dist/browser/unsafe-eval.min.js
  pixi-live2d-display-0.4.0-cubism4.min.js pixi-live2d-display 0.4.0 https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi-live2d-display@0.4.0/dist/cubism4.min.js

The unsafe-eval patch replaces PixiJS 6's `new Function` shader code, so the page needs no 'unsafe-eval' in its CSP.
It must be loaded right after pixi and before a renderer is created.
The Live2D Cubism Core is NOT vendored (Live2D's licence): it loads from
https://cubism.live2d.com/sdk-web/cubismcore/live2dcubismcore.min.js
